claims.claim_text: LeRobot v0.7.0 adds four world action models (Cosmos 3, Long-WAM, FLUX 3 Action, LaWAM) and four new VLAs (G0.5, LingBot-VLA 2.0, DM0.5, Wall-OSS-0.5).
claims.excerpt: It adds four world action models (Cosmos 3, Long-WAM, FLUX 3 Action, LaWAM), four new VLAs (G0.5, LingBot-VLA 2.0, DM0.5, Wall-OSS-0.5)

claims.claim_text: The Hugging Face Hub now hosts almost 300 TB of open Physical AI data in LeRobot format.
claims.excerpt: The Hub now holds almost 300 TB of open Physical AI data in LeRobot format, with some of the largest datasets released in just the past few months.

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 Nano and Cosmos 3 Edge reach 97.90% and 97.95% average success on LIBERO, according to the article's reporting of the model results.
claims.excerpt: which reach 97.90% and 97.95% average success on LIBERO.

claims.claim_text: LingBot-VLA 2.0 reports 93.5% success on RoboTwin 2.0 (clean), against 82.7% for π0.5, per upstream figures from Robbyant.
claims.excerpt: Upstream, it reports 93.5% success on RoboTwin 2.0 (clean), against 82.7% for π0.5.

claims.claim_text: The RPC LaWAM LIBERO fine-tune scores 98.5%, which is 1,970 of 2,000 episodes.
claims.excerpt: the LIBERO fine-tune scores 98.5% (1,970 of 2,000 episodes).

claims.claim_text: Long-WAM's two modes both land around 99% average success on LIBERO, with 99.00% for the Inverse-Dynamics Model and 98.45% for COD over 2,000 episodes each.
claims.excerpt: Both land around 99% average success on LIBERO (99.00% for IDM, 98.45% for COD, over 2,000 episodes each).

claims.claim_text: With disk-less streaming and four DataLoader workers, LeRobot's new reader gives 2.1–2.5x more samples per second.
claims.excerpt: The reader supports DataLoader workers, with 2.1–2.5x more samples per second when using four workers.

claims.claim_text: On an 8×H200 node training a 6B FastWAM, LeRobot's distributed checkpoints save checkpoints 3x faster and cut resuming peak memory from 143 GB to 42 GB per GPU.
claims.excerpt: On an 8×H200 node with a 6B FastWAM, DCP saves checkpoints 3x faster, and resuming peaks go from 143 GB to 42 GB per GPU.

claims.claim_text: ACT trains 2.8x faster on an H100 and 3.3x faster on an A100 when image augmentation runs on the GPU.
claims.excerpt: ACT trains 2.8x faster on an H100 and 3.3x faster on an A100.

claims.claim_text: G0.5's code and weights are released under the non-commercial G0.5 Community License, not Apache-2.0.
claims.excerpt: G0.5's code and weights are released under the non-commercial G0.5 Community License, not Apache-2.0.
